reason: B is more physically sound because pack aluminization supplies the Al reservoir needed to form a slow-growing protective Al2O3 scale, whereas A improperly extrapolates the fluorine effect from Al-containing TiAl and predicts protection by HfO2/Ta2O5 without supporting evidence. B is less quantitative and needs tighter process parameters and failure thresholds, but its controlled oxidation/mechanical comparison can directly test protection and coating-induced degradation.
